objective: Qualify narrow forensic instruments for current-byte codec structure, controlled recompression/resampling context, camera-acquisition consistency, provenance, and spoof resistance.
hypotheses: Static JPEG/metadata profiles are measurable and stable enough for context but are not authorship proof.
Controlled descendants expose some recompression/grid/resampling evidence, but complete edit history remains unknowable from final bytes alone.
Physical-device evidence requires repeated same-device references and cannot be inferred from one native-looking JPEG.
C2PA is a separate provenance evidence family, not an AI detector.

roles.development: 36 approved CSAFE/local originals across 14 device families
roles.confirmation: 24 previously consumed camera-claimed source families; not fresh acquisition and not device-instance ground truth

primaryUnit: source parent/source family, not descendant count
independentCrossChecks: ExifTool oracle via pinned Sherloq bundle
qualificationGates: unique sample IDs and parent-linked descendants
